combat_style.name: Invisible Court Style
combat_style.identity: Intelligence-led close-range one-handed katana and grappling discipline. Wei conserves chakra by solving threats through observation, movement, timing, terrain, tools, weapon work, and body control whenever those methods are sufficient.
combat_style.primary_rule: Treat an enemy hand-seal sequence as an attack and suppress it before discovering the intended jutsu.
combat_style.default_grip: katana in dominant hand; opposite hand free
combat_style.engagement_goal: End or decisively control the fight before the opponent completes a second meaningful hand-seal sequence.
priority_targets: neck only when player declares lethal force
combat_style.physical_first_rule: Use ordinary perception, positioning, terrain, katana, grappling, tools, and movement first when they can legally solve the problem inside the real timing window.
combat_style.technique_escalation_rule: Use the least expensive necessary Wind method when the physical answer is too slow, illegal, materially more dangerous, or tactically insufficient.

resource_posture.reserve_rule: Below 60 percent, subordinate jutsu use requires a strong timing, defense, rescue, escape, or mission-critical reason. Below 35 percent, autonomous expenditure is limited to preventing immediate death, capture, catastrophic mission failure, or severe harm to a protected ally.

combat_style.major_field_rule: Major fields are not routine answers. Use them only when the tactical problem justifies the cost and saved reserve doctrine permits it.
combat_style.rulers_domain_rule: Ruler's Domain is a major mobile suppression field, not an automatic freeze. Focused restraint trades broad control for stronger opposed restraint on one target; ally-safe corridors consume additional control.
combat_style.ultimate_authorization: Court of Ten Thousand Invisible Blades is never selected by subordinate automatic execution. It requires explicit player authorization after cost, setup, ally risk, counters, and reserve consequences are presented.
combat_style.player_override: Any explicit player instruction overrides this default within legal mechanics and agency protections.
